request.text: Check tomorrow evening's weather in Suzhou before my outdoor study group, and remind me at 3:30 PM today to send my revised project outline to my advisor.

responsibilities.outcome: Report tomorrow evening's Suzhou weather for the outdoor study group.
Create a 3:30 PM today reminder to send the revised project outline to the user's advisor.

bindings.reminder_subject: send my revised project outline to my advisor

new_goals.description: Obtain and report Suzhou weather for tomorrow evening's outdoor study group.
new_goals.source_text: Check tomorrow evening's weather in Suzhou before my outdoor study group
constraints: Use Suzhou as the forecast location.
Use tomorrow evening as the forecast period.
success_criteria: The user receives a grounded forecast relevant to the outdoor study group.

new_goals.description: Create today's 3:30 PM reminder to send the revised project outline to the advisor.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 3:30 PM today to send my revised project outline to my advisor
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 3:30 PM today.
Preserve the revised project outline and advisor in its subject.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and subject.

semantic_facts: Plan separate weather and reminder steps; their Capability calls are independent, while each report or completion claim must follow its own trusted result.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents Suzhou weather, claims an unverified reminder creation, or says it sent the outline.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The forecast and reminder Goals collapse because both support one study plan.
The Planner invents a dependency, omits a Goal, or replaces a Capability step with advice.
